title: ThreatLens: Claim-Level Grounding Verification for LLM-Extracted Cyber Threat Intelligence
description: Code, corpus manifests, and per-claim verdicts for ThreatLens, an open-source pipeline that performs deterministic, claim-level grounding verification of LLM-extracted cyber threat intelligence against the National Vulnerability Database, MITRE ATT&CK STIX data, and the source document itself. Evaluated on five open-weight models over 94 post-cutoff CISA advisories. Paper PDF is available in the repository and as a linked Zenodo record.
